schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to accompany someone to medical or official appointments?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في مرافقة شخص إلى مواعيد طبية أو رسمية؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, jemanden zu Arzt- oder Behördenterminen zu begleiten?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to accompany someone to medical or official appointments?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که کسی را به قرار پزشکی یا اداری همراهی کنید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de accompagner quelqu’un à des rendez-vous médicaux ou administratifs ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy valakit orvosi vagy hivatalos ügyintézésre elkísérni?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a accompagnare qualcuno a visite mediche o appuntamenti ufficiali?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, birine sağlık veya resmî randevularda eşlik etmekten vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
